name: Midas mRe7YIELD
oneLiner: mRe7YIELD is a Midas NAV-accreting liquid-yield token wrapping Re7 Capital DeFi lending, liquidity, restaking, and funding-rate strategies; not a fixed $1 peg.
collateral: Liquid Yield Token managed by Midas and Re7 Capital, allocating across institutional-grade DeFi yield strategies including lending, liquidity provisioning, restaking, funding-rate arbitrage, and options arbitrage
pegMechanism: mRe7YIELD is a NAV-accreting liquid yield token rather than a fixed $1 stablecoin; primary-market mint/redeem occurs through Midas rails while secondary-market holders rely on token liquidity and strategy NAV

proofOfReserves.provider: Midas transparency dashboard and issuer disclosures

jurisdiction.regulator: Liechtenstein FMA (prospectus-approving authority only; issuer not FMA-licensed)
jurisdiction.license: EU-Prospectus-Regulation-approved tokenized debt instrument (blockchain-based certificate under German law); EEA-restricted, not available to U.S. retail persons

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: Midas describes mRe7YIELD as tracking delta-neutral DeFi crypto yields. Its documented strategy uses delta-hedged stablecoin deployments, market-neutral liquidity provision, and market-neutral positioning to reduce directional exposure, which fits the synthetic-delta-neutral archetype.
